output.subject: We've received your concerns about your escrow analysis
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about your escrow analysis. We have received your complaint and want to confirm what you told us.

You mentioned that your recent escrow analysis shows a shortage of $742.50 and that your monthly payment is set to rise from $1,912.40 to $1,974.28 starting in November. You told us the analysis lists your property taxes as $11,840.00 for the year, while the tax bill you have from your town shows $8,120. You said you believe the wrong parcel or an outdated estimate may have been used, and you have asked us to redo the analysis.

We understand how concerning an unexpected payment increase can be, especially when the figures don't appear to match the bill you have in hand, and we're sorry for the worry this has caused.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days. If there is anything you would like to add in the meantime, please reply to this message.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Compare the $11,840.00 tax figure in the escrow analysis with the town's records and confirm the correct parcel is on file.
Decide whether to ask the customer for a copy of the $8,120 town tax bill.
Payment change takes effect in November; check whether a response or any adjustment is needed before the first increased payment is due.
Decide whether the escrow analysis should be rerun and, if so, what the corrected shortage and payment would be.
Customer's request to redo the analysis was acknowledged only; no outcome has been promised.
